{{Quote|She's uglier than a bantha wearing lipstick. It's not an insult if it's true.|[[Tora]], on Tanno Vik's mother|<ref name="KOTFEChapter6" />}}
'''Tanno Vik's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] living during the [[Great Galactic War]]. She died while putting her son [[Tanno Vik]] on a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he grew up an orphan. While Vik did not talk about his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] to other people, he did not tolerate insults to her either and believed that she was the best mother he could have.<ref name="KOTFEChapter6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tanno Vik's mother is mentioned during ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 6: Asylum'''. If the player is a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]], Vik will note that the player never once disrespected his mother.<ref name="KOTFEChapter6" />
